three_ids.context_id: 从入口到所有 worker 子任务全局不变，用于 ContextManager session key；也是 canonical Memory scope 的可信派生源（activate_runtime_scope）。
three_ids.task_id: 三层：coordinator 级由客户端分配；dispatch 级由 DispatchTaskTool 生成（dispatch-<n> 或 MissionGraph logical_id）；worker 级由 Worker 端 _setup_active_task 签发，Coordinator fast-ack 后绑定 worker_task_id→dispatch_id。
three_ids.query: 入口用户请求；dispatch 时变为 subtask instruction（安全模式下信封签名）；resume 时可能是 coordinator 回复文本。

design_points: 异步推送模式（return_immediately + push-callback + fast-ack 死锁修复）
EventSink 单向流 + TeeSink 扇出
threading 同步原语（SARBarrier 非 asyncio）
Step-based poll 循环与 A2A 编排并行
回调认证与幂等（CallbackProofV1 + nonce + 五族幂等键）
长期记忆/诊断 coordinator-only 注入边界
诊断通道绝不阻塞（D8 fail-closed）

critical_paths: 主数据流: Client → Coordinator(8081) → RouterAgent → Worker(8191+) → Barrier → push-callback(认证门) → EventStore → query_task_events → finish_task
INPUT_REQUIRED: AskCoordinator → NeedInputError → snapshot → INPUT_REQUIRED → help_request → send_message(reply_to_help) → resume
Token 双路径: Worker _step_callback + Coordinator router_cb → token_usage.csv / summary.csv
实验并行: A2A 编排与 experiment.py poll loop 共享 barrier
回调密钥流: per-run secret(32B) → CallbackSigner 签名 → /a2a/push-callback 认证门(verify→nonce→redact) → canonical/legacy 双写
长期记忆: rolling trigger → reflection port → LongTermMemoryStore → EnvironmentStateProvider(read ACL+budget) → ### Long-term Memory(coordinator-only)
诊断: trigger → DiagnosisLoop(4 只读工具, max_rounds=3/diagnosis_sec) → validate → diagnosis.sqlite3 + diagnosis.audit → ### System Health 注入
监督: TaskWatchdog tick → SupervisionStateStore + EventStore supervision_event + canonical → SARCoordinatorStateProvider payload[supervision] → pre_llm
